invariants.rationale: instantTime is a commit time string and is used in forming exceptions and as a method parameter, so it is expected to be non-null.
keys is used directly; method logic expects a collection of HoodieKey objects to process, so it must be non-null.
config is used immediately to obtain parallelism and configuration options; hence, it should always be non-null.
table is used to deduplicate keys and for record/data lookup, so it must be non-null.
deleteExecutor is required to perform delete operations and save metadata; being non-null is necessary for the main workflow.
